extract_batch with missing URI input

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract_batch

async def main() -> None:
    inputs = [{"kind": "uri", "uri": "/nonexistent/a.pdf"}]
    result = await extract_batch(inputs)
    print(result.summary.results)
    print(result.summary.errors)

asyncio.run(main())
```
